summary:
stroShield is an interactive space environment monitoring and risk intelligence platform developed using NASA radiation and environmental telemetry data. It analyzes radiation measurements from the ISS using two monitoring instruments and examines environmental parameters including temperature, humidity, and carbon dioxide.

The platform processes historical observations, identifies statistically unusual readings, groups radiation anomalies into time-based events, and presents the findings through interactive visualizations and a Streamlit dashboard.

Its Risk Intelligence Engine evaluates radiation and environmental anomalies separately, assigns transparent investigation-priority levels, explains the reasons behind each assessment, and provides recommendations for further review. It also considers the historical time periods of the datasets to avoid incorrectly interpreting observations from different periods as simultaneous events.

AstroShield aims to make complex space environment data easier to explore and understand, supporting data-driven investigation and awareness of unusual conditions during space missions.
details:
AstroShield is an interactive space environment monitoring and risk intelligence platform that analyzes NASA radiation and environmental telemetry data to help users explore unusual conditions recorded during space missions.

The project consists of two main monitoring modules.

  • The radiation module analyzes ISS radiation measurements from two instruments, DosTel1 and DosTel2, using absorbed dose rate and particle flux observations. Statistical anomaly detection is used to identify unusual readings, which are grouped into time-based events for further investigation.
  • The environmental module analyzes ISS temperature, relative humidity and carbon dioxide measurements, using previously generated anomaly indicators to identify unusual observations.
  • A Risk Intelligence & Recommendation Engine brings these analytical results together through three functions: radiation assessment, environmental assessment and overall assessment. It assigns transparent investigation-priority statuses, explains the evidence behind each assessment and provides recommendations for further review. It also considers dataset availability and historical time periods to avoid treating observations from different dates as simultaneous events.

The results are presented through an interactive Streamlit dashboard with metrics and visualizations that allow users to explore and refine the displayed data.

The project was developed using Python, Pandas and Streamlit. Its creative contribution is the integration of radiation analysis, environmental monitoring and explainable risk assessment into one accessible interface. The team considered data quality, missing measurements, statistical anomalies, instrument comparisons and timestamp alignment when designing the system.

AstroShield is a prototype decision-support and data exploration tool. Its statistical warning levels are intended to support investigation and are not certified spacecraft safety thresholds.
